strings.home.title: Campaign
strings.campaign.complete: Campaign complete. Replay any expedition with a different army.
strings.army.title: Choose your army
strings.army.run_locked: Your army is fixed for this expedition.
strings.briefing.title: Expedition briefing
strings.briefing.battles: Four battles. Choose an upgrade before each.
strings.tutorial.front: Deploy a Shieldguard to protect your army.
strings.tutorial.ranged: Deploy a Crossbowman behind your frontline.
strings.tutorial.rally: Use Rally to speed up your army’s attacks.
strings.draft.title: Choose an upgrade
strings.draft.ad_reroll: Watch an ad for one reroll
strings.draft.ad_unavailable: Ad unavailable. Choose an upgrade or retry later.
strings.results.last_battle: Rewards from earlier wins are already saved.
strings.pause.title: Paused
strings.pause.save_notice: A closed app restarts this battle from its beginning.
strings.abandon.title: Abandon this expedition?
strings.abandon.body: Your {medals} banked Medals stay saved. This army build and unfinished battle will be lost.
strings.shop.title: Shop
strings.shop.adfree_body: Claim the extra expedition reroll and eligible Medal bonus without watching ads. The usual limits still apply. Medal bonuses end when all Medal unlocks are owned. The free game has no forced ads.
strings.shop.adfree_exhausted: Claim one extra reroll per expedition without an ad. You already own every Medal unlock, so Medal bonuses are no longer offered. The free game has no forced ads.
strings.shop.cosmetic_body: One coordinated banner, shield marking, fortress trim and equipment-accent set. No combat advantage.
strings.shop.network: An internet connection is needed to purchase or restore.
strings.purchase.pending: Payment pending. Benefits unlock after the store confirms payment.
strings.purchase.success: Purchase restored or completed. Benefits are available.
strings.purchase.cancelled: Purchase cancelled. No benefit was added.
strings.purchase.failed: Purchase could not be completed. Check the store and try again.
strings.purchase.recovering: Purchase received. Verification will retry when connected. Do not buy it again.
strings.purchase.restore_none: No owned products were returned by this store account.
strings.purchase.revoked: The store reports this purchase is no longer owned. Contact support for purchase issues.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.save.failed: Progress could not be saved. Free device storage and retry. Your last valid save has been kept.
strings.save.backup: Your backup save was recovered. The most recent unsaved action may be missing.
strings.save.unreadable: Neither local save could be read. No automatic reset was performed.
strings.save.newer: This save was created by a newer game version. Update the app; your save has not been replaced.
strings.save.local_notice: Progress is stored on this device only. Reinstalling or changing devices may lose progress. Purchases can be restored separately.
strings.reset.title: Reset local progress?
strings.reset.body: Campaign progress, Medals, troop unlocks, earned banners and the current expedition will be erased. Purchases and privacy settings remain. This cannot be undone.
strings.service.offline: Offline. Battles and saved progress remain available.
strings.privacy.notice: Manage advertising and data choices. These choices do not block ordinary gameplay.
strings.support.missing: Support information is not configured in this development build.
strings.reward.failed: Your reward receipt is saved, but the grant could not be saved yet. Retry saving; do not watch another ad for this claim.

strings.unit.shieldguard.name: Shieldguard
strings.unit.crossbowman.name: Crossbowman
strings.unit.grenadier.name: Grenadier
strings.unit.brute.name: Brute
strings.unit.ram.name: Battering Ram
strings.upgrade.u01.title: Conscription
strings.upgrade.u01.body: Every fifth paid Militia deployment grants one additional Militia. Bonus spawns do not increment this counter.
strings.upgrade.u02.title: Scrap Blades
strings.upgrade.u03.title: Thick Coats
strings.upgrade.u04.title: First Into Battle
strings.upgrade.u04.body: Shieldguard carries a barrier worth 30% of modified maximum HP. Its 8-second lifetime begins on the first positive incoming damage, absorbing that hit. One activation per unit.
strings.upgrade.u05.title: Reinforced Shields
strings.upgrade.u05.body: Shieldguard flat damage reduction increases by 2.
strings.upgrade.u06.title: Heavy Boots
strings.upgrade.u07.title: Piercing Bolts
strings.upgrade.u07.body: A bolt may hit one additional enemy behind the first for 60% of the original bolt damage.
strings.upgrade.u08.title: Tighter Windlass
strings.upgrade.u09.title: Quick Reload
strings.upgrade.u10.title: Packed Powder
strings.upgrade.u11.title: Heavy Charges
strings.upgrade.u12.title: Fast Fuses
strings.upgrade.u12.body: Grenadier attack rate +20%. Projectile travel is unchanged.
strings.upgrade.u13.title: Sweeping Club
strings.upgrade.u13.body: Brute strikes also hit the nearest two additional enemy units within 0.8m of the primary target for 40% damage.
strings.upgrade.u14.title: Iron Belly
strings.upgrade.u15.title: Brutal Force
strings.upgrade.u16.title: Splintering Head
strings.upgrade.u16.body: Every third landed Ram hit on an enemy base deals an additional 100% of that hit’s direct damage to the base.
strings.upgrade.u17.title: Siege Engineering
strings.upgrade.u18.title: Reinforced Frame
strings.upgrade.u19.title: War Economy
strings.upgrade.u20.title: Deep Stores
strings.upgrade.u20.body: Supply capacity +50 and starting Supply +25 each battle.
strings.upgrade.u21.title: War Drums
strings.upgrade.u22.title: Field Training
strings.upgrade.u22.body: All troops gain +10% maximum HP and +10% damage.
strings.upgrade.u23.title: Rapid Orders
strings.upgrade.u23.body: Rally cooldown -5 seconds. The initial 12-second cooldown is unchanged.
strings.upgrade.u24.title: Forced March
strings.briefing.enemy_orders: Enemy reinforcements stop after 3:00. Existing troops keep fighting.

sdk_owned_text: Store and UMP screens use provider-required content, not hand-rewritten fake consent or billing dialogs.
